Onboarding to a new business solution is important for business productivity. We're continuing to focus on making it easier to adopt Business Central, and empowering partners to create better onboarding experiences for the business domains they serve. Feature Enabled for Public preview General availability Create engaging partner-specific trial and onboarding experiences Users by admins, makers, or analysts Mar 1, 2023 Apr 1, 2023

Further productivity improvement helping users working with Business Central and Microsoft 365 apps and services such as Outlook, Excel, Word, OneDrive, and Teams.
